title: Jonah and the Horizon
author: E. M. Sterling
blurb: Juniper Brightwater, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
